experiment: P3j multi-teacher consensus distilled ISRJ student
research_question: Can consensus supervision from all three frozen P1n teachers remove the seed-specific negative transfer seen in P3i while preserving single-main inference?
teacher_target: mean ISRJ probability of frozen P1n seeds 2041/2042/2043; soft-loss weight decreases with teacher standard deviation
student_inference: one seed-matched frozen MLCNN plus one compact shared-feature residual student; no teacher or UNet
loss: truth BCE + 0.5 uncertainty-weighted consensus BCE + 0.25 consensus-change BCE
stop_rule: If consensus distillation fails, freeze the compact-student branch and treat separated-waveform teacher information as not reproducible by the current cheap representation.
